🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-09-04 23:00 → 2026-09-05 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **Semantic ABI scope locked for ETHOnline** — The team formalized a deferral of the horizon-shield adapter to post-ETHOnline in version control, closing the build boundary cleanly before the event. [PR #3](https://github.com/trustless-ai/semantic-abi/pull/3)

> **ERC-8299 failure clause grounded in a real scenario** — The PoTT-M2 degradation condition was precisely mapped to the vantage_limitation codification, turning an abstract spec clause into a testable failure case with an exactly named condition. [tg:tawg:4330]

> **ERC-8004 moved from abstract proposal to concrete implementation** — Actual ReputationRegistry contract details entered the ERC-8004 discussion thread, giving contributors a specific on-chain anchor to evaluate and build against. [ERC-8004 post](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/393)

## 🤝 **What moved**

### semantic-abi

_The semantic-abi direction completed a coordinated pre-freeze sprint, landing schema fixes, real adapters, and a formal scope decision for ETHOnline._

- Pavlo **Submitted** a model-alignment fix for Semantic ABI v0, resolving schema inconsistencies before the freeze and giving every adapter a stable, shared base to build on. [PR #1](https://github.com/trustless-ai/semantic-abi/pull/1)
- Baby Blue Viper **Ported** the invinoveritas adapter to the expected_pair/observed_pair/backend_conformance interface, producing the first fully conforming adapter and validating the new paired-output model against a real case. [commit e158324](https://github.com/trustless-ai/semantic-abi/commit/e15832420b7c6350bbf4934ad90391e6af7a109f)
- A before-freeze commit delivered runner and schema fixes that make semantic edges claim- and scope-specific, a structural tightening required before adapters could safely reference the model. [commit 0a36370](https://github.com/trustless-ai/semantic-abi/commit/0a36370b930325f4f75994b00a41e6da5efb3670)
- A horizon-shield real adapter was opened with a manifest covering six declarations, grounding the adapter in the current model shape ahead of the scope decision. [PR #2](https://github.com/trustless-ai/semantic-abi/pull/2)
- Merlini (@gobross) **Recorded** the team's decision to defer horizon-shield to post-ETHOnline in a dedicated PR, converting a live scoping discussion into a documented boundary that protects the group's ETHOnline focus. [PR #3](https://github.com/trustless-ai/semantic-abi/pull/3)
- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Identified** verify_proof_event as the cleanest first surface for executable fixtures, pointing to its controlled input/output pair as the most tractable starting point for building the test harness. [tg:tawg:4311]

### ERC-8004 / ERC-8299

_Cross-spec analysis connected abstract failure-condition language to live implementation evidence, giving the group a reusable discipline across spec work._

- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Connected** the PoTT-M2 degradation clause to the vantage_limitation codification in ERC-8299, showing that both require naming the exact failure condition and equipping the group with a concrete pattern to carry into other specs. [tg:tawg:4330]
- Baby Blue Viper **Pulled** concrete ReputationRegistry implementation details into the ERC-8004 discussion thread, advancing the on-chain credential model from an abstract proposal to something reviewable and buildable. [ERC-8004 post](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/393)
- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Reviewed** a draft proposal and confirmed that its section 5 classification logic holds against a live case, providing the author with external real-world validation on the most contested design choice. [tg:tawg:4325]

### ERC-8183

_A focused nudge kept the agentic commerce open boundary visible and on the agenda._

- Cedric Brown **Flagged** one remaining open boundary in the ERC-8183 agentic commerce thread and noted a new reason to revisit it, ensuring a structural question in the spec does not quietly fall off the group's radar. [ERC-8183 post](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8183-agentic-commerce/27902/418)

### ERC tracking / research

_The group's ERC monitoring surface expanded and external research surfaced a potential input for trustless AI design thinking._

- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Requested** that ERC 8380 (unclonable agent execution credentials) be added to the group's ERC follow-up list, broadening TAWG's coverage to include a credential design directly relevant to trustless agent identity. [tg:tawg:4313]
- Merlini (@gobross) **Shared** an arxiv paper with more substantive content than its title suggests, flagging it as worth the group's attention for potential parallels with trustless AI design patterns. [tg:tawg:4327]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**

- ERC 8380's unclonable credential properties may intersect directly with ERC-8004 agent identity — worth an early read once it is on the list
- The PoTT-M2 / ERC-8299 vantage_limitation alignment hints at a cross-spec pattern for naming failure conditions that could apply broadly across the spec library
- The arxiv paper flagged by Merlini is a candidate for a closer read and a synthesis note if design parallels hold up

### ✅ **TODOs**

- Confirm ERC 8380 has been added to the ERC follow-up list
- Begin executable fixture work using verify_proof_event as the first surface, following Pavlo's suggestion
- Audit remaining ETHOnline open items; horizon-shield is deferred — verify everything else is scoped and clear
- Follow up on the ERC-8183 open boundary Cedric Brown raised

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A full coordination loop closed in the semantic-abi direction — schema fixes landed, a real adapter validated the paired-output model, and the team captured a scoping decision in a PR rather than leaving it as chat consensus.
>
> When your scope boundary lives in a merged PR, the whole repo knows the plan — keep shipping those tidy little closures! 🚢
